run_execute_python_code: run the execute_python_code method to execute arbitrary Python code via subprocess and return stdout
run_pipe_execute_code: run the pipe method to execute Python code from a user message string and return its output
run_pipe_generate_title: run the pipe method with body.title set to generate a pipeline title string
create_pipeline_instance: create a Pipeline instance with the name 'Python Code Pipeline' for use in Open WebUI
test_execute_python_code: test the execute_python_code method by passing Python code string and verifying stdout and return code
